messages:
nina: hey @devex i'm blocked on the starter sample. created a workspace, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run node sample.js and get a 403: 'workspace: default_permissions_missing'
chris_eng: can you paste the minimal repro and the response headers/body?
nina: repro:
```js
// sample.js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
c.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'hi' })
  .then(r => console.log(r))
  .catch(e => console.error(e.message));
```
error response (body): {"error":"403","message":"workspace: default_permissions_missing","hint":"enable_api_access or add billing method"}
samir_support: did you accept the workspace TOS and add a billing method during onboarding? we recently started blocking API access until onboarding is complete for new orgs
nina: i clicked through the UI but never added a card; assumed free credits would let me test firstcall
maria: confirm: onboarding-gate v2 was enabled 2026-02-14 14:03 UTC and will block generate endpoints for unconfirmed orgs. SDK currently surfaces a raw 403 which is confusing
nina: couple asks: 1) can the SDK include an actionable hint (accept TOS / add billing + link)? 2) is there a local dev bypass or header for testing?
chris_eng: filed DEVEX-1129 to return a structured hint and doc link from the SDK. there is no hosted bypass; for local/dev you can use the sandbox test token i'll share or add a billing method. also adding a note to quickstart README about the gate
samir_support: i'll DM a sandbox token and update the support KB with steps. we'll also add a tiny sample that checks for this error and prints next steps rather than raw JSON
maria: pinging product to add an inline CTA on the onboarding screen so users know why calls fail. thanks for reporting! :+1:
